verdict.rationale: Fathom documents admin visibility into shared content: admins can be granted View permissions on all users' shared calls, and an admin-only endpoint lists users and their permissions. Meetings are distinguished as 'recorded by you or shared to your team,' which implies sharing is scoped by team. However, private-by-default behavior and granular link/folder/workspace sharing permissions are not documented; folders appear only as a collaboration feature, with no permission controls described. Missing for 10: explicit private-by-default notes, granular link-level sharing controls, folder/workspace permission settings, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, sharing is controlled — private-by-default notes, granular link/folder/workspace permissions, and admin visibility into what's shared
